notes.title: The Alliance Alive HD Remastered Now Available on PC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34683108/1c72a9716d79665716788c82ecf8639aad703827.png[/img]

Rally your allies and take back the sky! [i][b]The Alliance Alive HD Remastered[/b][/i] is now available on PC all regions!

For a limited time, you can get a 10% launch discount on this grand adventure when you purchase on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027250/The_Alliance_Alive_HD_Remastered/][u]Steam®[/u][/url]. You can also pick up the [b]Digital Limited Edition[/b] for 12% off!

These special launch discounts end [b]Wednesday, January 22[/b], so take advantage of this deal while you can!

The following items are included with the Digital Limited Edition:

[i]Digital Game
Digital Artbook 
Digital Soundtrack[/i]
